about: The reasoning-effort records xbind ships (D249, docs/llm.md "Reasoning effort"): the lowest of three sources, under an admin's or host's entry (upstreams.<name>.reasoning) and the upstream's own model list. Keys as for prices: an exact id, the id after its last '/', or 'prefix*'. Each family was written from its provider's own page, read on the day given; a family or model whose levels its page does not state is left out (no record: callers' efforts pass untouched). Each family names its maker's own API hosts, as its docs give them, and applies only to an upstream at one of them (the host compared exactly): elsewhere — a router, a local server, a company's gateway — the same model id may take other levels, and a match is only a suggestion an admin may adopt. Left out on 2026-11-19/20: OpenAI (its reasoning guide gives defaults, not each model's levels), Gemini 2.5 and 3 (budgets, and no model ids), Qwen (Model Studio's API hosts are per workspace: none can be named exactly), Mistral's and xAI's other models.

families.read: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode and https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/list-models, 2026-11-19 (none turns thinking off; minimal→low, medium→high, xhigh→high; its GET /models says the same)
https://aistudio.google.com/docs/openai, 2026-11-19 (minimal→low; xhigh on these two; "Reasoning cannot be turned off for … Gemini 4 models")
https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/use-thinking-models, 2026-11-19 (no way to turn reasoning off is documented; the full assistant message, reasoning_content included, goes back)
https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/conversations/reasoning, 2026-11-19 ("If you omit reasoning_effort, Mistral Large 4 uses high"; no none)
